summary: Keep mission publication previews on one read snapshot while runs start concurrently

replay.detail: Read-only preview consistency changes; claim history and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored format changes.

rules.detail: No claim validation, checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The existing preview response and publication fences are unchanged; no client, protocol or harness transition is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or migration is required from any starting version.

recovery.detail: Revert the read snapshot wrapper to restore prior behavior; no stored-state repair is needed.
